main_text.l: Christi malè intellectis & detortis idolum faciamus. Patitur ergo nos verbis Christi in cœna abuti ad artolatriam, & quoduis aliud erroris genus: nec illi dolet aut repugnat, quòd sic nobis ipsi placentes, verbum Dei facere magni & reuereri videmur. eo enim pacto, nõ ad Dei voluntatẽ, sed ad diaboli obsequiũ, nostrúmq; placitũ, diuina oracula dirigimus: & hic Satanæ lusus est, vt stulti, dum tricas illius ab vna parte euitare volunt, alte ra incidant. Quò minùs igitur terrerimus verborũ Christi abusus animadverteretur, consecrationis titulo fuit ornatus: qua non aliter quàm pharmaceutriæ & sagæ suis carminibus in excatationibus, sunt vsi. At verò Christus cœnam suam instituens, ad discipulos verba sua protulit, non ad immutandum aut confundendum naturas rerum: sed ad erudiendum illos, vt ex ore magistri discerent quid sibi ceremonia illa, tum temporis noua, & toti in posterum Ecclesiæ commen-

page.notes: Several readings are uncertain at the scan resolution: "euitare" (the letters look like "cuitare") and "minùs" (accent unclear). Both are plausible but not checked against a larger image. The mark "b. iiii." is a gathering signature, not a catchword. The text ends with a printed hyphen at "commen-", so the continuation is on the next page. The running head is printed with a following colon-like mark, which is not transcribed.
